mintAuthority.summary: IDRX uses direct issuer-controlled minting. Complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked histories were established on 2026-07-30 for the reviewed Base, Polygon, BSC, Worldchain, and Lisk deployments, and the BSC roster was re-verified at pinned BSC block 135641119 (2026-11-25): MINTER_ROLE is held by issuer Safe multisigs (2-of-3, 2-of-4, 2-of-5, 2-of-6, 2-of-7, and 2-of-8 configurations by chain; on BSC, the 2-of-3 Safe and no-code counterfactual address had MINTER_ROLE revoked on 2026-11-06 and two Safe 1.5.0 multisigs, 2-of-6 and 2-of-7, were granted MINTER_ROLE on 2026-11-20 alongside the continuing 2-of-8 and 2-of-5 Safe 1.3.0 minters) plus one legacy Polygon minter EOA granted 2023-06-27 and never revoked. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, which can grant and revoke MINTER_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE, is held by the issuer ops EOA 0x5515be1db2a513888f5cf375bf5c7956ee93c779 plus 2-of-3 Safes (including BSC 0xfcdd28163ac6fe6bde0c508ccb2b62a86a26cd25, which retained DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE after its MINTER_ROLE revocation). UUPS upgrades route through UPGRADER_ROLE on per-chain TimelockController contracts (48 h minimum delay on Polygon, Worldchain, and Lisk; 1 s on BSC), but DEFAULT_ADMIN can reconfigure the role set without delay. On Solana, the current mint is controlled by a single System-Program key (Bpqui7hhcjfHoxwbkK4dw1GBB86Rt1DHEjQu8Mr7g8Tn), while the officially deprecated mint's authority is an autonomous Squads v4 2-of-3 multisig (CxFQVMMLzjXgN3eRXUr7mtyBGWxKPeWYJuX6Q97tEy5o) that cannot mint through standard Squads v4 flows; its residual ~77.85M IDRX supply sits outside the June 2026 attestation's Solana figure even though the issuer still honors 1:1 redemption. Gnosis, Etherlink, and Kaia are canonical issuer deployments, but their current per-chain role/controller inventories remain incomplete and are not claimed as exhaustively mapped here.
